title: Who is this?
hints: Calling `badge.onAdded(...)` directly works, but emitting `"added"` on the bus crashes. What's different about *how* the method gets called in those two cases?

`this` inside a method is decided by how the function is **called**, not where it was written. The bus calls each listener as a plain function `l(payload)`, so a method that was handed over on its own has no object in front of the dot.
Register a function that keeps the object: `bus.on("added", (item) => this.onAdded(item));`
